19 INTRODUCTION

22 March 31, 2009, filed in the instant case a petition to remove co-trustee Joanna Fujimoto and
23 appoint Marnie A. Scharmer as successor co-trustee. On April 1, 2026, Joanne Fujimoto
24 (“Respondent”) filed a motion to change venue to Contra Costa County. Petitioners filed an
25 opposition on May 14, 2026. Respondent filed a reply to Petitioners’ opposition on May 15,
